name: monitor-brief
title: Monitor investigation brief
for_each: select id,name from monitors order by name

sections.title: Recent checks
sections.sql: select observed_at,outcome,value,latency_ms,detail,maintenance from readings where monitor_id=$1 order by observed_at desc limit 25

sections.title: Follow-up commitments
sections.sql: select owner,note,due_at,closed_at,evidence from followups where monitor_id=$1 order by due_at

name: maintenance-brief
title: Maintenance window record
for_each: select w.id,m.name from maintenance w join monitors m on m.id=w.monitor_id

sections.title: Approved window
sections.sql: select starts_at,ends_at,reason,actor from maintenance where id=$1

sections.title: Checks during the window
sections.sql: select r.observed_at,r.outcome,r.detail from readings r join maintenance w on w.monitor_id=r.monitor_id where w.id=$1 and r.observed_at>=w.starts_at and r.observed_at<w.ends_at order by r.observed_at
